verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 37% of the time (377 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-4 pts, p=0.1173).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0032 (t=0.27) vs placebo 0.004 (t=0.4). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
